text:
alex: Heads up, PR #13555 is on hold — CI failing in the merge matrix: a visual snapshot and a time-sensitive unit test.
maria: Which jobs are red?
alex: unit/auth/session-time.spec.ts (asserts TTL/expiry) and visual/header-dark.png snapshot mismatch on ubuntu.
kevin: I can reproduce the snapshot diff on ubuntu-20 runner; macos-latest looks fine.
sophia: The snapshot looks shifted by 1px and the date string in the header changes format — smells like locale/font differences.
liam: Timezone or Intl differences then. Are we relying on toLocaleString anywhere in the header component?
alex: Yes, the header renders new Date().toLocaleString() for the small timestamp badge — we didn't mock locale in the test helper.
maria: That explains both flakes. For the TTL test the failure looks like a 1ms race when run with multiple workers.
kevin: Options: 1) proper fix (mock Intl/timezone + stabilize timers) 2) quick CI env change to force TZ=UTC 3) temporary retry/mark flaky to unblock.
sophia: Prefer 1 long-term but we need to unblock the merge. TZ=UTC in CI for PR matrix seems low-risk.
liam: I can add TZ=UTC env on PR matrix jobs and set NODE_ENV vars for visuals to reduce font variance.
alex: I'll push a tiny CI patch on branch pr/13555/ci-tz to set TZ=UTC for the failing jobs.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by @alex -> https://ci.redwood.com/runs/4721
jenkins: rerun started: matrix run 4721
maria: Also please open a follow-up ticket to properly mock Date/Intl and audit other components that call toLocaleString.
kevin: I'll mark the unit test as flaky on PR runs only if the env tweak doesn't fully stabilize it, but will create a ticket to remove the flaky marker after root fix.
sophia: And I'll open an infra ticket to pin fonts/chrome for visual tests if we keep seeing tiny diffs.
liam: Pushed CI env tweak: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/commit/abc123 (branch pr/13555/ci-tz)
jenkins: matrix 4721 finished: unit-ubuntu passed, visual-ubuntu still shows 1px shift but TZ=UTC made date formatting consistent across runners.
alex: Good — can reviewers re-run and give thumbs up? @maria @kevin
maria: Re-running final checks locally then will approve once green in CI.
kevin: Created INF-861 (root cause: mock Date/Intl + timer stability) -> https://issues.redwood.com/INF-861
sophia: Created INF-862 (pin visual test fonts/chrome) -> https://issues.redwood.com/INF-862
jenkins: final run 4723: all green after CI env tweak. Merge hold cleared.
alex: Merging now, will follow up on INF-861 and INF-862.
maria: Thanks all — resolving thread. :thumbsup:
